name: Virtuous Woman
overview: Scripture portrays the virtuous woman as a rare and invaluable treasure, whose worth surpasses that of rubies and who is widely recognized for her noble character, as seen in Ruth 3:11 and Proverbs 31:10. She is a source of wisdom and kindness, speaking with thoughtful words that build up her household (Proverbs 31:26; 14:1). Her influence extends to honoring her husband and strengthening her family, embodying the ideal of godly womanhood described in Proverbs 12:4 and the teachings imparted to King Lemuel in Proverbs 31:1.
